podcast.title: Project Revolution Performer (2003)
podcast.body: Mudvayne was among the bands that performed during the 2003 Project Revolution tour. "The 2003 tour included Mudvane"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Collaboration with Garth Richardson
podcast.body: Garth Richardson worked on projects with Mudvayne. "That led to more work with everyone from Motley Crew to 5440 and Kitty and Mudvane and Chavelle and the Catherine Wheel and Trapped."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Face and Body Paint, Masks, and Uniforms
podcast.body: Mudvayne utilizes extensive face and body paint, masks, and uniforms in their performances and image. "Mudvane uses a lot of face and body paint and masks and uniforms."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Pronounced Metal Leanings
podcast.body: Mudvayne was noted for having "much more intense" musical leanings due to their pronounced metal elements within the new metal genre. "Other bands were much more intense because of their pronounced metal leanings, ... mud veins."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
